name: Workflow Example with React Flows, Next.js & Shadcn
summary: Sample interactive workflow builder with draggable nodes and flow validation, built with React Flow, Next.js and shadcn/ui.
description: A demo project showing how to build and visualize interactive workflows: five predefined node types (Start, Menu, Text Message, Tags, End) on a React Flow canvas, drag-and-drop connections between nodes, and validation that prevents incomplete flows from being finished. Node components are modular so new node types can be added.
contains: predefined nodes: Start, Menu, Text Message, Tags, End
drag-and-drop connections on a React Flow canvas
